title: core.material — PBR material parameters
description: One file per material_id. The shading model is metallic-roughness, the same one glTF 2.0 uses, because it is the boring ubiquitous choice (law 11). Every factor is a number in a declared range; nothing is an application preset.

base_color_factor.description: [r,g,b,a] in LINEAR space, 0..1. Multiplied with the base-color texture, which is itself sRGB-encoded and must be linearised first. The factor is linear and the texture is sRGB: that asymmetry is glTF's and is restated here so nobody has to remember it.

roughness_factor.description: Perceptual roughness. Squared to get the GGX alpha.

emissive_strength.description: Multiplier on emissive_factor, allowing values above 1 for HDR emitters.

ior.description: Index of refraction of the dielectric base layer.

alpha_mode.description: Lowercase here, unlike glTF's uppercase, because conventions.id_case is kebab-case and one casing rule beats two.

textures.description: Texture slots. Each slot names a core.tex NODE (identity, law 4) and mirrors its path for convenience. A reader MUST resolve through the manifest and MUST report a mismatch between 'node' and 'path' rather than silently preferring one.

uv_set.description: Which UV channel of the geometry to sample.

uv_transform.description: Applied as uv' = rotate(scale * uv, rotation) + offset, in that order. Stated because the three common orderings give three different results.

channel.description: For packed textures, which channel carries this slot. Only meaningful for metallic_roughness (glTF packs occlusion=R, roughness=G, metallic=B) and occlusion.

epistemic.description: Restated inside the payload so the node is an island (law 3). MUST agree with the manifest version's stamp.
